description: This PHP file contains a migration class for database schema updates specific to version 4.3.3 of the OrangeHRM system. It defines schema modifications, foreign key management, and schema alterations involved in the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for executing database schema migration steps for version 4.3.3 of OrangeHRM, including altering columns, managing foreign keys, and resolving conflicts in the database schema.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration, removing conflicting foreign keys and modifying column types and attributes in specific tables.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier of this migration, '4.3.3'.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign key constraints that conflict within certain tables and need to be dropped or recreated during migration.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints identified as conflicting to allow schema changes.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Restores previously dropped foreign key constraints after schema modifications.
